entities.summary: The Royal Moroccan Navy is a branch of the military of Morocco responsible for conducting naval operations. The Royal Moroccan Navy is administratively managed by the Administration of Defence, which is commanded by King Mohammed VI, the commander-in-chief of the Moroccan Armed Forces.
